item.title: Neo Classical Bungalow Exterior Design
item.description:
This project explores a contemporary interpretation of Neo-Classical residential architecture, combining traditional architectural principles with modern living requirements. The design is centered on symmetry, balanced proportions, and carefully articulated façade elements that establish a strong and timeless visual identity.

The front elevation is defined by grand arched openings, Corinthian-inspired columns, decorative cornices, dentil mouldings, balustrades, and layered projections that create depth through light and shadow. Large glazed openings enhance natural daylight while maintaining the formal rhythm characteristic of classical architecture. A restrained material palette of warm off-white stucco, natural timber, charcoal wrought-iron railings, and blue ceramic roof tiles reinforces the elegance of the composition.

item.title: Compact Bedroom Interior Design
item.description:
Designed within a compact 15’-5" × 9’-2" footprint, this bedroom focuses on maximizing storage while maintaining a warm and uncluttered spatial experience. The layout is driven by a continuous built-in storage wall that integrates wardrobes, overhead cabinets, display niches, and shoe storage into a single cohesive system.

A key feature is the storage-lined passage behind the bed, leading to the attached bathroom. This transitional space doubles as functional storage while maintaining clear circulation. At its end, a full-height backlit mirror creates a subtle dressing area and enhances the sense of depth.
